metadata.quality_filter: local changed-face minimum angle only; global q05 is endpoint audit, not per-step guarantee
metadata.normal_filter: strictly positive old/new face-normal dot product
metadata.timing_scope: Python OFF serialization + native process startup/read/preaudit/QEM/guards/postaudit/write + Python output read; build excluded

metrics.distance: trimesh accelerated nearest point on full triangle surface
metrics.normalization: 100/reference surface bbox diagonal; no per-mesh rescaling

audit.valid_scope: single closed oriented genus-zero surface; stored endpoints only
